steps.en: Install it with the cask or the release ZIP and open it
steps.zh: 用 cask 或 release 压缩包装上并打开

steps.en: Fetches the catalogue from formulae.brew.sh and reads your Caskroom for what is installed
steps.zh: 从 formulae.brew.sh 取目录，读 Caskroom 看已装项

steps.en: Browse the shelves or search, then click Install
steps.zh: 逛分类货架或搜索，然后点安装

steps.en: Runs the real brew install, with a native password dialog for pkg-based casks
steps.zh: 跑真正的 brew install，pkg 类 cask 弹原生密码框

steps.en: Adopt an app you installed outside Homebrew so brew manages it in place
steps.zh: 把 Homebrew 之外装的 App 收编，让 brew 就地接管

value.en: An App Store front end whose installs stay fully manageable from the brew command line, and vice versa
value.zh: 一个应用商店式前端，装出来的东西在 brew 命令行里照样能管，反之亦然

sources: README.md Install (brew install --cask caskhub; release ZIP)
README.md How It Works (catalog and analytics from formulae.brew.sh; installed detection reads $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/Caskroom; installs, updates and uninstalls run through your real brew binary)
README.md Features (Adopt Apps, guided Homebrew setup with custom install paths, native password prompts for pkg casks, popularity charts, Sparkle updates)
README.md Requirements (macOS 15.6 or later; Homebrew required for install/update/uninstall)
README.md Architecture (SwiftUI + MVVM; dependencies Sparkle, Sentry, TelemetryDeck)
